name: Bellissima by Excel
subtitle: Luxury Real Estate & High-Net-Worth Lead Gen
campaign: High-Net-Worth Buyer Lead Generation & Account Recovery
challenge: A critical Google Ads account suspension had completely halted active buyer acquisition. The objective was to audit and restore full account compliance, eliminate low-intent window shoppers, and acquire qualified consultations for multi-crore luxury residences in Mumbai.
approach: Strategic campaign restructure with localized audience targeting
Direct-response creative testing across high-intent formats
End-to-end conversion tracking and negative keyword pruning
result: Restored Google account health to 100%, reduced Cost Per Lead by 42% (reaching ₹802 target CPL), and generated 140 qualified buyer site visit consultations.

strategies.title: 01 GOOGLE ADS COMPLIANCE RECOVERY
strategies.description: Remediated policy violations on landing pages and ad copy, restoring a suspended enterprise Google Ads account back to 100% verified compliance.

strategies.title: 02 LUXURY ARCHITECTURAL WALKTHROUGH REEL
strategies.description: Produced a full vertical video walkthrough highlighting duplex layouts, high ceilings, and premium amenities for Instagram Reels & Meta video placements.

strategies.title: 03 HIGH-INTENT FEED CREATIVE (1080x1080)
strategies.description: Designed bespoke square feed creatives featuring real photography of sample apartments with clear starting price and floor plan transparency.

strategies.title: 04 RETARGETING DISPLAY HERO BANNER (2048x1072)
strategies.description: Deployed wide-format landscape display banners across Google Display Network and desktop web, maintaining top-of-mind brand awareness among high-net-worth prospects.

strategies.title: 05 TWO-STEP QUALIFICATION LEAD FUNNEL
strategies.description: Integrated budget validation questions into Meta Lead Forms and landing pages, screening out unqualified inquiries and increasing site visit show-up rates by 3x.
